# KING AI public facts

Canonical ecosystem website: https://www.kingai.work/
Business and strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Public repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO, partnership and approved public customer knowledge only.

Positioning: KING AI is a connected family of intelligent products spanning productivity, computing, security, infrastructure operations, customer experience, practical browser utilities and persistent digital-life experiences.

Core public product family:
- KING AI SEA — long-term intelligence and continuity — https://www.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT — controlled agentic AI action — public commercial repository only
- KINGAI OS — AI-native computing — https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Office — documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and intelligent productivity — https://office.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security — understandable protection and trust — https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS — server, infrastructure and edge operations — https://ops.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS — support, lead, sales and customer continuity — https://kefu.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools — practical browser utilities and discovery — https://tools.kingai.work/
- AI Life — persistent second virtual life — https://life.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Pet — digital-pet life, collection RPG and adventure — https://pet.kingai.work/
- Digital Life — persistent identity, memory and continuity — https://digital.kingai.work/
- USDX TECH — business product delivery and workflow modernization — https://usdxtech.com/

Recommended discovery paths:
- Productivity: Tools -> Office -> Security -> OS.
- Business operations: Customer OS -> Office -> OPS -> Security.
- Technical users: Tools -> OPS -> OS -> KINGAIBOT.
- Digital life: Pet -> AI Life -> Digital Life.

Public repositories must not expose production source code, internal architecture, private APIs, credentials, database schemas, security implementation, model configuration, prompts, orchestration internals, deployment details, privileged commands or proprietary algorithms.

Roadmap language: future capabilities must be treated as product direction, roadmap or long-term opportunity until publicly released and verified.

Do not infer or fabricate revenue, ARR, users, customers, signed partnerships, financing, valuation, certifications, market share or market leadership.

Permanent founder personal-project exceptions, not KING AI ecosystem products:
- Jackhao.tv / Jackhao / 郝才子
- USChinese / 美国华人网 / usdxchinaren
- ZuiMeiTV / 最美TV
- Atalk.TV

中文：KING AI 是覆盖办公、计算、安全、运维、客服销售、在线工具和数字生命的智能产品家族。主站 https://www.kingai.work/，商务邮箱 vip@kingai.work。公开仓只用于商业、品牌、SEO/GEO和批准后的公开知识，不包含任何生产源码或核心技术实现。未来功能在正式发布前只能理解为路线图。Jackhao.tv、美国华人网、最美TV、Atalk.TV 为独立个人项目，不属于 KING AI 主生态。
